policy_authorization: Existing owner-approved HYBRID live/demo mixing and synthetic catalogue; no new implicit real service or zero-priced exclusion.

scope.notice: Демонстрационный трансфер; стоимость и наличие вымышлены. Трансфер поставщика не бронируется.

trust_boundary: The catalogue is pure and does not grant real geography authority. Public selection and current catalogue admission remain server-owned; no HTTP occurs in this generator.
refresh_path: API preview validate_quote -> external component refresh + deterministic reprice_plan for DEMO -> assemble_plan exact catalogue -> validate_quote -> new quote -> explicit idempotent simulated confirm.
verified_controls: Only an otherwise complete transfer gap is filled; failed hotels, flight identity, unknown fees/allocation or unsupported hard criteria stay blocking.
All transfer prices participate in the hard whole-trip budget; native RUB amounts are preserved and foreign budget projection requires reference FX.
US city named Москва cannot use name-based Russian DEMO hotel or flight snapshots.
Two homonymous physical references retain different place/country identities.
One offer covers each eligible stay, all passengers exactly once and sufficient explicitly synthetic vehicle capacity.
Foreign dates/stays/passengers/place/country/price/capacity changes are rejected as unknown DEMO snapshots.
Synthetic provider/catalogue/ID namespace cannot be relabelled SANDBOX/LIVE with fabricated supplier flags and TTL.
Policy false preserves the old incomplete branch and a policy revision invalidates old quote consent.
A real supplier fee-evidence loss during refresh blocks quote and old confirmation; the synthetic transfer does not repair it.
Search, refresh and repeated simulated confirmation create exactly one BOOKED_DEMO order without a supplier booking.

preserved_failures_and_policy_history.old_three_partial_supplier_tests: Only set demo_fallback=False to retain their unchanged old no-fallback and air-identity assertions; policyTrue has separate new MIXED checks.
preserved_failures_and_policy_history.source_label_complete_red_result: Three forged labels bypassed the own catalogue and produced no blockers before the small namespace guard. This is a reproduced internal assembler contract gap, not a demonstrated public endpoint exploit.

limits: Mixed/demo completion is not a real transfer offer, live availability or payment; ready_for_real_booking remains false.
Standalone self-arranged transfer/budget exclusion is deferred; no unknown expense was silently removed from whole-trip budget.
The operator's actual world run uses its own immutable package and is reported separately; this receipt does not convert historical PARTIAL into PASS.
No source corpus80/106/D250 acceptance is implied by these188 controlled tests.
